mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book(bookNo, bookName, bookAuthor, bookPrice, bookDate, bookStock, pubNo) VALUES (#{bookNo}, #{bookName}, #{bookAuthor}, #{bookPrice}, #{bookDate}, #{bookStock}, #{pubNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET bookNo=#{bookNo}, bookName=#{bookName}, bookAuthor=#{bookAuthor}, bookPrice=#{bookPrice}, bookDate=#{bookDate}, bookStock=#{bookStock}, pubNo=#{pubNo} WHERE bookNo=#{bookNo}
mapper.select: SELECT bookNo FROM book WHERE bookNo= #{bookNo}
